Ancient gold rings discovered at Thai archaeological site

Archaeologists have unearthed gold rings estimated to be 2,000 years old at an ancient burial site in Thailand. Some of the rings reportedly feature Brahmi script. The discovery was made during an excavation at the archaeological location.
